Task 2 Bilinear interpolation involves simultaneously linearly interpolating in two directions. Given points (x1, y1), (x1, y2), (x2, y1), and (x2, y2), we can first interpolate in the x direction at y = y1 and at y = y2. f (x, y1) = x2 − x x2 − x1 f (x1, y1) + x − x1 x2 − x1 f (x2, y1), f (x, y2) = x2 − x x2 − x1 f (x1, y2) + x − x1 x2 − x1 f (x2, y2), Then we can linearly interpolate in the y direction between f (x, y1) and f (x, y2).
